No quick-start example, oracle, control, other-case context or scorer feedback. Plain JSON syntax constraint; no answer schema constraint, retries, repairs or acceptance. Non-thinking mode. The designer owns and can inspect this authored synthetic suite; this is not a blind independent study. The model has no tools or filesystem access.
